description: This file defines an interface class 'f1u_tx_delivery_handler' for handling notifications related to PDCP PDU transmission, delivery, retransmission, and delivery retransmission in a 3GPP F1-U bearer context within the OCUDU project.

classes.name: f1u_tx_delivery_handler
classes.description: Interface class for handling transmit and delivery notifications of PDCP PDUs in F1-U bearer context.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Handles transmit notifications from lower layers, informing about the highest transmitted PDCP sequence number and desired buffer size.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Handles delivery notifications from lower layers, indicating the highest delivered PDCP sequence number.

methods.name: handle_retransmit_notification
methods.description: Handles retransmit notifications from lower layers, indicating the highest retransmitted PDCP sequence number.

methods.name: handle_delivery_retransmitted_notification
methods.description: Handles delivery retransmitted notifications from lower layers, indicating the highest delivered retransmitted PDCP sequence number.
